```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { View, Text, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { useFrameworkReady } from '@/hooks/useFrameworkReady';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

const ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY = '@TaskFlow:hasSeenOnboarding';

export default function RootLayout() {
  useFrameworkReady();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkOnboardingStatus = async () => {
      try {
        console.log('Checking onboarding status...');

        // Clear onboarding status for testing (remove this line in production)
        await AsyncStorage.removeItem(ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY);

        const hasSeenOnboarding = await AsyncStorage.getItem(
          ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY
        );

        console.log('Onboarding status:', hasSeenOnboarding);

        if (hasSeenOnboarding !== 'true') {
          console.log('Navigating to onboarding...');
          // User hasn't seen onboarding, redirect to onboarding screen
          router.replace('/(tabs)/onboarding');
        } else {
          console.log('Navigating to main app...');
          // User has seen onboarding, go to main app
          router.replace('/(tabs)');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking onboarding status:', error);
        // Default to showing onboarding if there's an error
        router.replace('/(tabs)/onboarding');
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    // Add a delay before checking onboarding to ensure navigation is initialized
    const timer = setTimeout(checkOnboardingStatus, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            backgroundColor: '#3B82F6',
          }}
        >
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#FFFFFF" />
          <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', marginTop: 16, fontSize: 16 }}>
            Loading TaskFlow...
          </Text>
        </View>
        <StatusBar style="light" />
      </GestureHandlerRootView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
        <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        <Stack.Screen name="+not-found" />
      </Stack>
      <StatusBar style="auto" />
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```
